details.description: Seat of the city council. Brightwater is a harbour city of almost 50,000 people.
The city's park, with a duck pond and the old oak.
The tallest building in Brightwater: offices and a sky bar.
Brightwater FC's home ground. Tonight: the harbour derby.
Parcels for the whole city are sorted here; the roof is covered in solar panels.
Moorings for 60 boats, a fuel dock and the ferry terminal.
Crosses the bay from the marina to Long Beach every half hour.
Live traffic on the ring road around downtown.
The best view of the bay, at the top of the hill road.
